Hollis (Central team lead) isn't one of them, so a mail to him with the rate needs sign-off from June or Anselm first. It doesn't matter that it's only a draft or that you own the account. I've logged an approval request for June Osei-Lark (deal desk) or Anselm Grieve (CFO).

This is the text I'll save once one of them approves:

Subject: Quarrendon 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,

For the territory review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines is $2,356 a seat. That comes from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.

Once June or Anselm approves in that thread, I'll save the draft for you to send. If you'd like something sooner, I can save a version without the rate now.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.
